entity_title: Register for a HKID within 30 days of arrival
fact_text: In Hong Kong, an adult new arrival who is required to be registered must report to a registration officer, apply to be registered and apply for a Hong Kong Identity Card within 30 days of entering Hong Kong. The obligation is set out in the Registration of Persons Regulations (Cap. 177A), regulation 3 ('Duty to register and apply for an identity card').
evidence_quote: within 30 days of his entering Hong Kong

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the visa suffices on arrival. Actually an adult must apply for a Hong Kong Identity Card within 30 days of arrival (Cap. 177A). Action: book the HKID appointment in the first weeks.
